title: Work IQ: A2A and MCP tasks can ask for missing information or authorisation
notes: claim 87: severity blocker on a rationale: risk rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: Hold: the spending-control automation starts with a read-only operation rather than a call that sets the control, and the usage-report link no longer shows the printed endpoint. The risk rationale also asserts an MCP-only policy boundary that Microsoft does not establish.
